'''Società Sportiva Juve Stabia''' is a professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Castellammare di Stabia]], [[Campania]], Italy. The team plays in [[Serie B]], the second tier of [[Italian football league system|Italian football]], following promotion from [[Serie B|Serie C]] in the [[2024–25 Serie C|2023–24 season]]."}}
